**Claimed by the `domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`) — graded p1 and dispatched in the same pass.**

Claimed: objectui#9372 — an unmapped operator erases the stored dataset filter
Clause-②: no

## Graded **p1**, same as objectui#9363

Same destruction, same gesture, four more ordinary menu picks. The partition was **computed** by objectui#9363's seat, not inferred — the union of `operatorsForFieldType` over 16 probe field types with no `extraOperators`, each id driven through `groupToCondition`, behind a totality ratchet. `between` · `endsWith` · `notContains` · `startsWith`, all default-menu entries here.

## ⭐ The ruling: (ii) before (i), and (ii) is not optional

The card lists three options over *which operators to map*. ⛔ That framing hides the part carrying the p1. Split it:

| | |
|---|---|
| **(i)** which operators map to the dialect | a per-operator conformance question, genuinely open |
| **(ii)** what happens when one does **not** map | **not open** — erasing the stored filter is wrong whatever (i) answers |

**RULING: fix (ii) first and unconditionally.** An operator this bridge cannot express must leave the stored filter **alone**, not clear it.

The mechanism is named in the card: `undefined` means *"the author cleared the filter"* **and** *"nothing survived serialization"*, and the caller treats both as clear. ⇒ that conflation is what makes an unmapped operator **destructive rather than inert**, and it is reachable **not only** through the four operators but by blanking the value of the only row. Fixing it retires the whole class.

Then on (i): map what a per-operator conformance reading supports — `notContains` / `startsWith` / `endsWith` are the candidates; `between` stays out until it has a both-bounds-present completeness rule. ⛔ Any operator whose conformance reading does not come back clean stays **unmapped and inert**, never unmapped and destructive.

⛔ **Option C as the card poses it is ruled out**: relying on the partition pin keeps four ordinary menu picks destructive, and a pin that reddens a *future* addition does nothing for the four already there.

## Why the file's own justification does not defend the status quo

```
if (!mop) continue; // unmapped (e.g. notContains/between) — drop rather than emit a bad filter
```

Measured against pinned `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0, `FILTER_OPERATORS` contains **`$notContains`, `$startsWith`, `$endsWith` and `$between`**. ⇒ "operators this dialect genuinely cannot express" is **stale for all four**. The drop is four unhandled operators falling into the fallback's path — the same reading objectui#9363 made about `isNull`.

⚠️ ⛔ But the comment's *original* intent still has to survive the repair: emitting a filter in a spelling that means something else is worse than dropping. That is why (ii) is "leave the stored value alone", ⛔ not "emit something".

## What objectui#9363 already left in place

Its offered-versus-expressible partition pin, and the value-less arms consolidated into one table with `$null` kept distinct from `$exists`. ⇒ the enumeration is done; this card does not redo it.

⚠️ One hop stays **NOT MEASURED** and is carried forward honestly: whether a full-document metadata save is a replace or a merge on the server. The draft is destroyed either way — `objectChangePatch` uses `{ filter: undefined }` deliberately as the spelling for CLEAR — so the p1 does not rest on it.
